page.overview:
Who is Prim Posy?

Prim Posy is a female Pegasus pony with a grayish blue coat, pale yellow mane and tail, orange eyes, and a cutie mark of three purple umbrellas.__TOC__

Prim Posy shares her design, cutie mark, and sometimes eye color and/or skirt accessory design with Parasol, her design, eye color, and accessory designs with "Sky Flower", her design, cutie mark, and accessory designs with "Drizzle", her design and eye color with Sassaflash, Honey Rays, "Bluebird Happiness", "Cinnamon Swirl", "Cloud Showers", "Shocking Pink", "Sandstorm", "Snowslide", "Wind Chill", "Blue Diamond", "Blue Emerald", and S02E18 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #3, her design and accessory designs with "Tiger Lily", her design and skirt accessory design with "Graceful Falls", her design with "Cream Tangerine", "Downdraft", "Riverdance", S01E20 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #2, S04E08 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #1, S04E13 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #1, S04E20 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #1, and normally "Flower Flight", her mane and tail style and eye color with Green Jewel and "Welly", her mane and tail style with "Chilly Puddle" and "Purple Haze", her mane style and eye color with "Chocolate Blueberry", and her color scheme and flower accessory design with "Doseydotes".

Prim Posy, along with Lemony Gem and "Serena" and as well as "Tornado Bolt", Cotton Cloudy, "Princess Erroria", "Noi", Aura, Liza Doolots, "Dinky Doo", "Pinkie Feather", "Rainy Feather", "Mango Dash", and "Sweet Pop", was to appear in Friendship is Magic, part 2.

Prim Posy first appears in The Ticket Master. She also appears in Call of the Cutie at Diamond Tiara's cute-ceañera. She later appears at the Grand Galloping Gala in The Best Night Ever, singing during At the Gala at one point.
